gen-gf-gabarito-gf-wix-madefor-text: Gabarito draws every stroke like a bent paperclip, with open terminals that let the counters flow outward. Wix Madefor Text takes over below in a sans with easy open endings, and Gabarito is happiest big and brief.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ysabeau: Expressive and a little unruly, Gabarito cuts every stem and curve from one gauge of tubing. Ysabeau follows in sweeping, approachable sans-serif curves that never close up, so shrinking the heading would waste the character it carries.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ysabeau-infant: Ysabeau Infant reads approachable and contemporary, its sans-serif terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs. And Gabarito, with no pressure swells where the eye might slow down, gives the pairing its steady, expressive spine.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office reads modern, with every curved letter left open at the end. Gabarito leads with a ruler-and-compass feel to its line, then hands the text to that sans, so the page moves from drawn display to easy reading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC reads modern, its c gaping visibly at any size. Gabarito excels with a thickness that never shifts with direction, while the plain sans simply keeps its wide-mouthed shapes legible in the text beneath.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zalando-sans: Wiry, bent-wire strokes with open ends: that is Gabarito at a glance. And Zalando Sans, approachable in its sans curves left open on every round letter, gives that constant line somewhere softer to land.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Gabarito's flat, contrast-free letterforms and open-cut terminals make it unmistakable. Zalando Sans Expanded counters in the sans text, spacing its letters widely with c tips that never creep toward touching, where the heading does its loudest work.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpa: Joints without a bulge or a pinch, that's Gabarito, expressive and drawn with one nib. And Zalando Sans SemiExpanded, a plain sans with open-mouthed c, e, and s, lets that heading speak first and then talks quietly below it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei reads modern and clean, its thick strokes only slightly heavier than the thin ones. Gabarito runs a unit-width stroke throughout, so the sans-serif text and its heading differ in temperament while sharing a tidy restraint.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiq: Gabarito is all open-cut terminals and one-nib confidence, a heading with real personality. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique, a clean sans-serif, would make a small heading feel timid.
